findings.evidence: `ContinuousLinearMap.coe_id'` (`Mathlib/Topology/Algebra/Module/ContinuousLinearMap/Basic.lean:388`) and `coe_id` (:384) exist precisely because these terms are not syntactically equal; Mathlib's own `LinearMap.index_id` (`Mathlib/Algebra/Module/LinearMap/Index.lean:68`) is guarded by `set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false`, so defeq around `LinearMap.id` in this API is already known to be delicate. The diff shows the deleted proof `rw [index_def, ContinuousLinearMap.coe_id, LinearMap.index_id]`.

summary: The Basic.lean helper cleanup is an improvement (hand-rolled `ext x; simp` coercion bridges replaced by Mathlib's `toLinearMap_comp` / `toLinearMap_toContinuousLinearMap`), but two index-zero lemmas in the new `Fredholm/Index.lean` were rewritten into term proofs that match only up to unstated definitional equality across the `≃L`/`→L`/`→ₗ`/FunLike wrappers, replacing proofs that previously used explicit Mathlib lemmas.
